properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: hash.js@1.1.3 is pinned in the v2-core yarn.lock (line 3362) as a transitive dependency of elliptic (which ethers v5 pulls in for key handling). No direct first-party call site — the package ships SHA-1/SHA-2 implementations with the build, available to any code in the dependency graph. Changeable here: it is a dev-toolchain lockfile pin.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: elliptic@6.3.3 (locked at yarn.lock:2030) supplies the secp256k1 ECDSA that ethers v5 uses to sign test transactions/accounts in the Uniswap V2 core suite. Quantum-unsafe signature (Shor), deadline risk rather than harvesting. Changeable here via the toolchain pin.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Capability of the same shipped elliptic package as ALG-710f61f0/LIB-a0bfbc1a: ECDH key agreement over P-256 et al. No first-party ECDH call site found in repo code; the algorithms are available in the shipped dependency closure. Migration when ECDH use ever appears: ML-KEM-768 hybrid.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: tweetnacl@0.14.5 (locked at yarn.lock:6381) is a transitive dep of ethers v5 in the test toolchain. X25519 scalar-multiplication key agreement ships with the build; no first-party call site. Quantum-unsafe (Shor) but no recorded traffic to harvest — it is a dev toolchain capability.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: scrypt-js@2.0.3 (yarn.lock:5614) is ethers v5's memory-hard password KDF (keystore files) in the test toolchain. Quantum-safe as a KDF; no urgency. No first-party call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: secretbox AEAD from the same tweetnacl@0.14.5 package as ALG-defedad1/LIB-0469707e (other shard). Symmetric AEAD, quantum-safe. No first-party call site; ships in the dependency closure.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The crypto library dependency itself: elliptic@6.3.3 locked at yarn.lock:2030, reached via ethers v5 for the Uniswap V2 core test suite. Its ECDSA/ECDH capabilities are separately recorded as ALG-710f61f0 and ALG-c9ffc8a8 — same package, three views of one dependency. No direct first-party import; available in the shipped dependency closure.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: pbkdf2@3.0.17 (yarn.lock:5011) enters via elliptic's browserify pipeline under ethers v5 in the test toolchain. PBKDF2 KDF capability ships with the build; no first-party call site. The v2-periphery lockfile (not covered by the deterministic pass) declares the same package.
